senses.gloss: f. (אכף; cmp. b. h. אֶכֶף) burden, care, solicitude, followed by ל־ of the person concerned.
units: <cite ref="Targum of I Chronicles 21:13">Targ. I Chr. XXI, 13</cite> <cite ref="A01748"><he>אִיכַּפַת</he></cite>.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 5:2:9">Y. Sot. V, 20ᵇ</cite> top <he>וביתא מאי אכפה ליה</he> what concern is the Temple to him? <cite ref="Taanit 25a:5">Taan. 25ᵃ</cite> <he>מאי אי׳ לך</he> why should that trouble thee? <cite ref="Bava Metzia 40a:6">B. Mets. 40ᵃ</cite> <he>וכי מאי א׳ וכ׳</he> what do the mice care whether &c.
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 4:1:1">Koh. R. to IV, 1</cite> <he>זה מה אי׳ ליה</he> what concern is it to this one (if the other sinned), i.e. why should he suffer for it?; a. fr.

<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 10:1">Pesik. R. s. 10</cite>, beg. <he>אי׳ להם</he> will people care for them (miss them)? <cite ref="Gittin 62a:8">Git. 62ᵃ</cite> <he>מכפת לא אכפת ליה</he> should he not care for it? Cmp. <he>כפת</he>.
